section.content: The invention relates to the technical field of soft-package lithium batteries, and discloses a soft-package battery assembly method using an aqueous binder, which comprises the following steps: (1) preparing positive and negative electrode slurry; (2) slurry coating; (3) cutting the positive and negative plates; (4) lamination; (5) assembling; (6) injecting liquid; the composite modified water-based adhesive adopted by the invention takes deionized water as a solvent, is more environment-friendly, and is a composite contemporary environment-friendly theme. After the composite modified water-based adhesive prepared by the invention is adopted, the overall connectivity between the anode material, the cathode material and the pole piece can be formed, so that the ion transmission resistance of the electrode is reduced, and the electrochemical performance of the soft-package battery is improved.

本发明涉及软包锂电池技术领域，且公开了一种使用水性粘结剂的软包电池组装方法，包括以下步骤：(1)正负电极浆料制备；(2)浆料涂布；(3)正负极片切割；(4)叠片；(5)组装；(6)注液；本发明采用的复合改性水性粘结剂以去离子水作为溶剂，更加绿色环保，复合当代绿色环保的主题。采用本发明制备的复合改性水性粘结剂后，能够使得正极材料与负极材料、极片之间形成整体的连接性，从而减小电极的离子传输阻力，提高了软包电池的电化学性能。

Soft package battery assembling method using aqueous binderTechnical Field

The invention relates to the technical field of soft-package lithium batteries, in particular to a soft-package battery assembling method using an aqueous binder.

Background

A lithium ion battery is a secondary battery (rechargeable battery) that operates mainly by means of lithium ions moving between a positive electrode and a negative electrode. During charge and discharge, li + To-and-fro intercalation and deintercalation between two electrodes: during charging, li + De-intercalation from the positive electrode, and intercalation into the negative electrode through the electrolyte, wherein the negative electrode is in a lithium-rich state; the opposite is true when discharging.

Lithium ion batteries have been rapidly developed since commercialization in 1991, and are widely used in hand-held electronic devices, electric transportation devices, and stationary energy storage systems.

The pouch battery is one of lithium ion batteries, and in the pouch battery, a binder is a very important material, and although the binder is used in a low proportion in the pouch battery, it plays a very important role, mainly in binding positive and negative active materials, a conductive agent and an electrode.

In the prior art, N-methyl pyrrolidone (NMP) is mostly adopted as a dispersion solvent of slurry, and polymer polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF) is adopted as a binder, however, the organic solvent, namely N-methyl pyrrolidone, is required to be used, is inflammable, causes pollution to the environment after evaporation, is toxic, has irritation and corrosion injury to human skin, has slight amine smell and injury to human respiratory system, and needs to be further improved along with the continuous enhancement of environmental protection consciousness of people, so that the prepared soft-package battery is more in line with green environmental protection.

Based on this, we propose a method for assembling a flexible battery using an aqueous binder, which is expected to solve the disadvantages in the prior art.

Disclosure of Invention

(one) solving the technical problems

Aiming at the defects of the prior art, the invention provides a soft package battery assembling method using an aqueous binder.

(II) technical scheme

In order to achieve the above purpose, the present invention provides the following technical solutions:

a method of assembling a pouch cell using an aqueous binder, comprising the steps of:

(1) Preparing positive and negative electrode slurry: respectively preparing positive electrode slurry and negative electrode slurry;

(2) And (3) slurry coating: uniformly coating the prepared positive electrode slurry on the surface of a copper foil, and drying in a drying chamber to obtain a positive electrode plate;

wherein the drying temperature is 75 ℃ and the drying time is 5 hours;

uniformly coating the negative electrode slurry on the surface of a copper foil, and drying in a drying chamber to obtain a negative electrode plate;

wherein the drying temperature is 75 ℃ and the drying time is 5 hours;

(3) Cutting the positive and negative plates: cutting the positive electrode plate and the negative electrode plate prepared in the step (2) into the required size and shape;

(4) Lamination: assembling the positive and negative plates and the diaphragm together, and assembling the positive and negative plates and the diaphragm into a pole core after rubberizing is completed;

(5) And (3) assembling: filling the pole core prepared in the step (4) into an aluminum plastic film, performing top sealing and side sealing operations, and reserving a liquid injection port to form a soft package battery without liquid injection;

(6) And (3) liquid injection: and (3) injecting the electrolyte into the soft-package battery without the electrolyte, pumping out the gas in the soft-package battery in a vacuum environment, and sealing.

As a further technical scheme, the preparation method of the positive electrode slurry in the step (1) comprises the following steps: mixing lithium manganese phosphate, a composite modified water-based binder, carbon nanotubes and water together, and fully stirring and dispersing to form anode slurry;

the preparation method of the negative electrode slurry comprises the steps of mixing graphite, a composite modified water-based binder, carbon nanotubes and water together, and fully stirring and dispersing to form the negative electrode slurry.

As a further technical scheme, the mixing mass ratio of the lithium manganese phosphate, the composite modified aqueous binder, the carbon nano tube and the water is 38-43:2-4:1-1.5:4-5;

the mixing mass ratio of the graphite to the composite modified water-based binder to the carbon nano tube to the water is 40-45:3-5:1.2-1.8:4.5-6;

wherein deionized water is used as water.

As a further technical scheme: the preparation method of the composite modified water-based adhesive comprises the following steps:

adding dioxane into a reaction kettle, adding azodicarbonyl valeric acid into the dioxane, stirring and mixing uniformly, introducing nitrogen into the reaction kettle, discharging air in the reaction kettle, adding acrylic acid, butyl acrylate, ethyl acrylate and nano auxiliary agent into the reaction kettle, regulating the temperature to 80 ℃, carrying out heat preservation and stirring reaction for 15 hours, standing for 1 hour, and carrying out vacuum drying to obtain the composite modified water-based adhesive.

As a further technical scheme, the mixing proportion of the dioxane, the azodicarbonyl valeric acid, the dioxane, the acrylic acid, the methyl acrylate and the nano auxiliary agent is as follows: 15g:40mg:3g:1g:1g:0.3-0.5g.

As a further technical scheme, the preparation method of the nano auxiliary agent comprises the following steps:

first, a modifier is prepared:

adding raw silk into sodium bicarbonate solution according to the mass ratio of 1:30, then adjusting the temperature to 95 ℃, preserving heat and stirring for 4 hours, and then dialyzing for 20 hours to obtain sericin solution;

adding methacrylic anhydride into the sericin solution prepared by the method, stirring and reacting for 10 hours at 5 ℃, and dialyzing for 20 hours to obtain a modifier;

adding graphene into a modifier, stirring for 4 hours at the temperature of 40 ℃, then performing ultrasonic treatment for 10 minutes, and performing suction filtration, washing and drying to obtain a nano auxiliary agent;

the concentration of the sodium bicarbonate solution is 1.5g/L;

the methacrylic anhydride accounts for 2-3% of the total mass of the sericin solution.

As a further technical scheme: the dialysis bag specification adopted by the dialysis: mw is 8000-14000.

As a further technical scheme: the diaphragm is polyvinylidene fluoride diaphragm.

As a further technical scheme, the electrolyte in the step (5) is prepared from the following components in parts by weight: 15-20 parts of lithium salt, 1-5 parts of vinylene carbonate, 2-4 parts of fluoroethylene carbonate and 70-80 parts of dimethyl carbonate.

As a further technical scheme: the lithium salt is prepared by mixing lithium difluorooxalato borate and lithium phosphate according to a mass ratio of 1:3.

(III) beneficial effects

Compared with the prior art, the invention provides a soft package battery assembling method using an aqueous binder, which has the following beneficial effects:

because the traditional polyvinylidene fluoride has high internal resistance, and the adopted N-methyl pyrrolidone has hygroscopicity, the electrochemical performance and the service life of the finished soft-packaged battery can be obviously influenced, and therefore, the invention can effectively avoid the use of the organic solvent N-methyl pyrrolidone by adopting the composite modified water-based adhesive to replace the polyvinylidene fluoride, simultaneously avoid the use of the polyvinylidene fluoride with high internal resistance, and optimize and improve the electrochemical performance of the soft-packaged battery.

The composite modified water-based adhesive adopted by the invention takes deionized water as a solvent, is more environment-friendly, and is a composite contemporary environment-friendly theme.

After the composite modified water-based adhesive prepared by the invention is adopted, the overall connectivity between the anode material, the cathode material and the pole piece can be formed, so that the ion transmission resistance of the electrode is reduced, and the electrochemical performance of the soft-package battery is improved.

The composite modified aqueous binder adopted in the invention has higher electrical electrode peeling strength, is prepared by reacting dioxane, azo dicyanovaleric acid, dioxane, acrylic acid, methyl acrylate and nano auxiliary agent, can further enhance the bonding stability, can be more uniformly dispersed by modifying graphene, can also perform specific supplement to the conductive agent, improves the conductivity, enhances the conductive network, plays an extremely critical role in maintaining the structural stability of the electrode and improving the battery performance, and shows that the performance of the composite modified aqueous binder has an important influence on the electrochemical performance of the electrode.

The composite modified aqueous binder prepared by the invention can not swell electrolyte, and can maintain higher mechanical strength, thereby effectively maintaining the stability of an electrode structure in the charge and discharge process.
